name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '25' is the per-event handler-table index 0x25 (xref site 0x51c25), a meaningful dispatch-slot ID, not an address remnant. Descriptor corrected from '__unref_major_cinematic' to '__ch12_orc_leader_defeat': the slot is LIVE, reached via the ch12 kill-drop path -- ch12 char_spawn_record[1] = the orc leader (獸人隊長, enemy_data 35, char_id 0x67, lv16) carries pickup_kind=2 param=0x25, so the orc leader's death dispatches consequence[0x25]. The body is his defeat cinematic (page-1 defeat line + 2-stage cutscene). The earlier 'unref' verdict only scanned turn-event/tile-step hooks and missed the kill-drop path.
purpose: Chapter 12 orc-leader-defeat cinematic (dispatch slot 0x25, reached via the ch12 kill-drop path when the orc leader record[1] enemy_data 35, pickup_kind=2 param=0x25, falls): show dialog page 1 (his defeat line) then play a 2-stage portrait+cutscene cinematic and flip battle-animation phase to 1.
logic_summary: Straight-line, no branch/RNG/numeric-compute, no CALL-return used. fd2_display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text, page=1, fixed dialog geometry). Stage A: fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0xF,0x22); chapter_init_phase_flag=1; fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(3); chapter_init_phase_flag=0; fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x2B); fd2_clear_all_chars_facing(). Stage B: fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0,0x1A); chapter_init_phase_flag=1; fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(4); chapter_init_phase_flag=0; fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x2C); fd2_clear_all_chars_facing(). Closes with battle_anim_phase=1. Each portrait load is bracketed by the init-phase flag. __CHK(0x28) prologue; EBX untouched; final store reached via tail-JMP 0x34D63 -> 0x35C18 (MOV [0x51A83],1; RET) shared epilogue tail, inlined in src for Layer-2 equivalence.
